books.title: The Burning of the Realm
books.description:
Meet Page, a burned-out millennial healthcare worker who steps out into traffic intending to end it all. Instead, he wakes up in a fae realm. Pulled through a portal by Shaylee, an ancient fae living on an isolated island with her giant pet rabbit. Together, they must navigate their new reality and work together to open another portal to their own realms. Somewhere along the way, Page and Shaylee must confront a question they never expected: How do you keep living when all you wanted to do was disappear? The Burning of the Realm is the first novel in the Realmfire Series that blends humor, healing, mythology, and epic fantasy adventure.
